SELECT 
  AVG(
    CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS real)
    + 0.5 * CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS real)
    - CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS real)
  ) AS avg_sustainability_adjusted_loss
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON fm.casetag = r.casenum;

SELECT 
  r.casenum,
  CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS real) as shipping_fee,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS real) as restocking_fee,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS real) as relabeling_cost,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS real) as disposal_cost,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS real) as repair_estimate,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS real) as carbon_footprint,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS real) as recovery_value,
  (CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS real)
    + CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS real)

    + 0.5 * CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS real)
    - CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS real)
